newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: AlliedSignal in 17 mln pound Irish expansion.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal in 17 mln pound Irish expansion.

text.p: Ireland's IDA development agency said on Tuesday AlliedSignal Inc would undertake a 17 million Irish pound expansion of its Waterford facility.

IDA said the investment would transform the installation from the company's sole precision foundry for turbocharger wheel castings into a fully integrated operation supplying world markets with finished compressor and turbine wheels.
Established in 1979, the operation employs almost 450 people and has three businesses in Waterford, in southeast Ireland.
The company is a subsidairy of AlliedSignal Inc of New Jersey.
